0022600003.text: Both teams open their 2026-27 seasons when the Oklahoma City Thunder visit the San Antonio Spurs. Otega Oweh is out for the Thunder after Achilles surgery, while the Spurs will be without Jayden Quaintance (knee surgery), and Tobias Harris is day-to-day with a calf strain and is a game-time decision. The Thunder lost 1-4 to the Spurs in the 2025-26 season and 3-4 in the 2025-26 playoffs, and their most recent meeting was a 111-103 loss in Oklahoma City on May 30. ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Thunder a 45% chance of winning.
